:::{#cor-qp-sensitivity}
#### The multiplier is the sensitivity of the minimum value

In @thm-qp-equality, write the minimum value as a function of $\vecf{b}$,
$f^*(\vecf{b}) = \tfrac{1}{2}\,\tp{\vecf{b}} \matr{M}^{-1} \vecf{b}$.
Its sensitivity to $\vecf{b}$ (@def-sensitivity) is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\vecf{b}} f^*(\vecf{b})
&= \matr{M}^{-1} \vecf{b} \\
&= -\vlagmult^*.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::

::: proof

$\matr{M}^{-1}$ is symmetric and does not depend on $\vecf{b}$,
so [derivative of a quadratic form](vector-calculus.qmd#thm-quadratic-form) applies with $\matr{M}^{-1}$ in place of $\matr{S}$:

$$
\ba
\deriv{\vecf{b}} f^*(\vecf{b})
&= \tfrac{1}{2}\,\deriv{\vecf{b}} \paren{\tp{\vecf{b}} \matr{M}^{-1} \vecf{b}}
&& \text{(constant multiple)}
\\
&= \tfrac{1}{2} \paren{2 \matr{M}^{-1} \vecf{b}}
&& \text{(derivative of a quadratic form)}
\\
&= \matr{M}^{-1} \vecf{b}
&& \text{(simplify)}
\\
&= -\vlagmult^*.
&& \text{(definition of } \vlagmult^* \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-qp-sensitivity}
#### Moving the line

In @exm-qp-equality with a general right side $b$ in place of $5$,
$\matr{M}^{-1} = \tfrac{2}{25}$ and

$$
\begin{aligned}
f^*(b) &= \tfrac{1}{2} \paren{\tfrac{2}{25}}\,b^2 \\
&= \tfrac{b^2}{25},
\end{aligned}
$$

so $\dif{}{b} f^*(b) = \tfrac{2b}{25}$.
At $b = 5$ this derivative is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\tfrac{10}{25} &= 0.4 \\
&= -\lagmult^*:
\end{aligned}
$$

moving the line $3 x_1 + 4 x_2 = b$ outward by a small step $\smallconst$ in $b$
raises the minimum value by about $0.4\,\smallconst$.

:::
